source: lib/editorials/b12-deficiency-signs.ts (the site's article of the same title)

lines.text: Tired all the time? Pins and needles in your feet? It might be vitamin B12. Here are the five signs to take seriously, the test that confirms it, and who really needs a supplement.
lines.say: Tired all the time? Pins and needles in your feet? It might be vitamin B twelve. Here are the five signs to take seriously, the test that confirms it, and who really needs a supplement.

lines.chapter: Why it is easy to miss
lines.text: B12 deficiency is easy to miss. Your liver stores enough to last two to five years, so symptoms creep in slowly. But left untreated, it can damage nerves for good.
lines.say: B twelve deficiency is easy to miss. Your liver stores enough to last two to five years, so symptoms creep in slowly. But left untreated, it can damage nerves for good.

lines.text: Sign one. Tiredness, weakness and breathlessness that rest does not fix. Without enough B12, you make fewer red blood cells, so less oxygen reaches your muscles and brain. On its own, this is the least specific sign.
lines.say: Sign one. Tiredness, weakness and breathlessness that rest does not fix. Without enough B twelve, you make fewer red blood cells, so less oxygen reaches your muscles and brain. On its own, this is the least specific sign.

lines.text: Sign two. Pins and needles, or numbness, in your hands and feet. This is the one that should get you to a doctor soonest, because nerve damage can start before any anaemia shows up.
lines.say: Sign two. Pins and needles, or numbness, in your hands and feet. This is the one that should get you to a doctor soonest, because nerve damage can start before any anaemia shows up.

lines.text: Sign three. Problems with balance and coordination. Feeling unsteady, especially in the dark, or stumbling. These need prompt medical assessment.
lines.say: Sign three. Problems with balance and coordination. Feeling unsteady, especially in the dark, or stumbling. These need prompt medical assessment.

lines.text: Sign four. A sore, red tongue and mouth ulcers. The cells lining your mouth are replaced quickly, so they are among the first to suffer.
lines.say: Sign four. A sore, red tongue and mouth ulcers. The cells lining your mouth are replaced quickly, so they are among the first to suffer.

lines.text: Sign five. Memory problems, low mood or confusion. In older people these are often put down to age, but when deficiency is the cause, they can improve with treatment.
lines.say: Sign five. Memory problems, low mood or confusion. In older people these are often put down to age, but when deficiency is the cause, they can improve with treatment.

lines.text: None of these proves you are low in B12. A blood test is the only way to know. And tell your doctor if you already take a supplement, because it changes how the result is read.
lines.say: None of these proves you are low in B twelve. A blood test is the only way to know. And tell your doctor if you already take a supplement, because it changes how the result is read.

lines.text: So who really needs a supplement? Vegans, without exception. At least 10 micrograms a day, or 2,000 micrograms once a week.
lines.say: So who really needs a supplement? Vegans, without exception. At least ten micrograms a day, or two thousand micrograms once a week.

lines.text: Most people over 50. With age there is less stomach acid to free B12 from food, so lean on fortified foods or a small supplement.
lines.say: Most people over fifty. With age there is less stomach acid to free B twelve from food, so lean on fortified foods or a small supplement.

lines.text: And anyone on metformin, or a long-term acid-reducing medicine such as omeprazole, should ask their doctor about a check.
lines.say: And anyone on metformin, or a long-term acid-reducing medicine such as omeprazole, should ask their doctor about a check.

lines.text: One warning. Pernicious anaemia, the most common cause in the UK, is not fixed by a shop-bought supplement. It needs medical treatment, usually injections.
lines.say: One warning. Pernicious anaemia, the most common cause in the U K, is not fixed by a shop-bought supplement. It needs medical treatment, usually injections.

lines.text: Who does not need one? If you are under 50, eat meat, fish, eggs or dairy, and take neither medicine, you almost certainly get enough. And no, B12 will not give you more energy unless you were deficient.
lines.say: Who does not need one? If you are under fifty, eat meat, fish, eggs or dairy, and take neither medicine, you almost certainly get enough. And no, B twelve will not give you more energy unless you were deficient.

lines.text: Which kind? Cyanocobalamin is the most common and usually the cheapest. No form has been shown to be better than the others.
lines.say: Which kind? Cyanocobalamin is the most common and usually the cheapest. No form has been shown to be better than the others.

lines.text: So. Take the five signs seriously, especially pins and needles or balance problems, and get a blood test rather than guessing. This is general information, not medical advice. The full guide is at sharpandlean.com.
